# AssetRipper type-tree data

`classdata.tpk` is the pinned `lz4.tpk` artifact generated by AssetRipper/Tpk.
It supplies built-in Unity player type trees for stripped serialized files;
PlateUp's Unity 2020.3 files have type trees disabled. KitchenLib Studio reads
this data only in the Unity Editor while inspecting an installed PlateUp copy.

See `NOTICE.md` for exact provenance, contributor acknowledgement, and license
status. This data is not covered by KitchenLib Studio's root MIT license.
